title: Bounded membership and coded reachability
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $s,K$ be natural numbers satisfying $2^{\mathrm{codeK}(N)(s+\mathrm{logSpace}(|x|)+1)}\le K$. For every natural number $t$, $t$ belongs to the set of numbers below $K$ that satisfy the initial-code condition and are connected to $t$ by a walk of at most $K$ steps of the encoded transition relation if and only if $t$ is reachable from the code of $N$’s initial configuration on $x$ by a finite sequence of encoded transitions at space bound $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
